Legal professions in England and Wales | Legal professions in England and Wales are divided between two distinct branches under the legal system, those of solicitors and barristers.  Other legal professions in England and Wales include being judges, as well as the roles of Attorney-General, Solicitor-General, and Director of Public Prosecutions.
Girl on the Bridge | Girl on the Bridge (French: La fille sur le pont ) is a 1999 French film shot in black and white and directed by Patrice Leconte, starring Daniel Auteuil and Vanessa Paradis.
Simon Gokana | Simon Gokana was a Congolese politician.  He was a nurse by profession.  Gokana served as Minister of Public Health and Population between April 1965 and August 1968.
Young professional (disambiguation) | A Young professional is a young person not in school who is employed in a profession or white-collar occupation.
